content.short: Zempafy is a versatile Cardano platform featuring an NFT marketplace and professional CRM tools for teams.
content.description: Zempafy is a multifaceted platform on Cardano that has evolved from a specialized NFT marketplace into a comprehensive toolset for real estate and mortgage professionals. Created by Jason Appleton, the project offers an agent portal and CRM system designed to streamline referral tracking and gamify client outreach. On the NFT side, Zempafy provides creators with a secure environment to sell digital assets with built-in royalty support and community governance. By bridging the gap between Web3 art and real-world business needs, Zempafy provides unique utility for a diverse audience.
